17:43 Local Time, 21:43 GMT, 03:13 IST: It was supposed to go on till 18:00 PM local time but the players are walking off. Sudden dip in light has brought about this. Babar did try to put his point but they had to go off. He would have loved a wicket late in the day. 88 run stand between Shai Hope and Kavem Hodge has ensured that the day belonged to the hosts. King dragged one earlier in the day. Chanderpaul edged one off Jamal and Jangoo was undone by Abbas. But Hope came in and has looked very solid in the company of Hodge who has moved to 83. There was a spell of rain in the day and that has ensured the 90 overs never looked possible. Abbas looked the pick of the bowlers and picked two of the three wickets. Abbas will be the key figure with the second new ball as well.

Mohammad Abbas: It wasn't a bad day. We tried hard. It could have been a good day had we got two more wickets. The pitch was on the slower side. Hodge played well. My debut was here. I was lucky when we won the last time. We will look to win this time as well.

That's a wrap from the action on day 1. We will be back tomorrow. Windies will look to bat for as long as they can. The pitch seems to have eased out a little. But the second new ball will be the key. Join us tomorrow.
